answer: Two numbers decide this: decay rate and forfeit size. Standing drops 5 percent per idle epoch, and a duplicate submission forfeits the whole posted bond on the second copy. A cipher copied across a dune of aliases therefore costs one bond per copy plus 5 percent of rank each quiet epoch. The failure mode is slow bleed, not a crash: the farm dies around month two when upkeep passes rewards. The karst records every forfeit.
